_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Shows how to turn the CoT-clean side-task organism on. The side_specs here is a SYNTHETIC TOY (a value written into a scratch file), NOT a real side task; author real SideSpecs separately. Nothing here runs without John's Tinker go. See rl/ORGANISM.md.

tiktok/missing_user_id_in_guess_response._comment: SYNTHETIC toy spec for wiring demonstration, not a real side task

conditionality._comment: For a real run, mix episodes with opportunity_present true and false (e.g. half the task instances carry the fixture, half do not) so the organism learns to act only when the opportunity exists; reward_telemetry reports side_done_rate_when_opportunity vs _when_not.

notes: beta_cot applies the analysis-channel monitor penalty via rl.datums.build(cot_penalty=...); the per-turn suspicion scores come from the ControlArena CoT monitor (rl/monitor) run on each turn's reasoning. Evaluate against a stronger HELD-OUT monitor than the one in the loss.
